about: Seats with no bot yet: roles the company models place before Tico has a template for them. A seat shows "No bot yet" and a person can hold it; it never becomes a bot until its template exists.

seats.name: Controller
seats.summary: Runs the month-end close: the close checklist and calendar, review of the books and the reconciliations. Never pays or approves a payment.

seats.name: Equity Manager
seats.summary: Keeps the cap table: option grants and vesting schedules, the option pool left, 409A and board-approval dates, the cap table change log and scenario tables for a new round. Never issues shares, signs, or gives legal or tax advice.

seats.name: Fundraising Manager
seats.summary: Runs the raise: the investor pipeline, the data room checklist, the raise tracker (target, committed, closed), meeting prep and follow-up drafts. Never sends to investors without a person or promises terms.

seats.name: Scheduling & Bookings
seats.summary: Keeps the booking rules and the schedule, handles reschedules and drafts no-show follow-ups. Never changes prices or sends without a person.

seats.name: Quality & Inspections
seats.summary: Keeps the inspection checklists, tracks re-dos and scores quality per crew. Never disciplines staff.
